characters.name: Edward Elric
characters.trait: Brilliant, reckless, and fiercely loyal.

characters.name: Alphonse Elric
characters.trait: A gentle soul in steel armour.

characters.name: Roy Mustang
characters.trait: Ambition with a lighter in hand.

characters.name: Winry Rockbell
characters.trait: Wrench in hand, heart on sleeve.

quote.text: A lesson without pain is meaningless.

synopsis: After a forbidden ritual costs them dearly, brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric set out to restore what they lost.
Their search for the Philosopher's Stone pulls them into a conspiracy that runs to the top of the nation of Amestris.
Alchemy here has rules, costs, and consequences — and every shortcut demands payment.
A complete story about family, guilt, and what a life is actually worth.
anime.tagline: Two brothers. One forbidden price. A country built on a lie.
anime.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood

writer.bio: Manga artist from Hokkaido whose work pairs rigorous worldbuilding with dry humour. She planned Brotherhood's full story before serialization, which is why it lands its ending so cleanly.
writer.name: Hiromu Arakawa
otherWorks: The Heroic Legend of Arslan (manga adaptation)

characters.name: Eren Yeager
characters.trait: Rage with a reason.

characters.name: Mikasa Ackerman
characters.trait: Loyalty sharpened to a blade.

characters.name: Armin Arlert
characters.trait: Strategy over strength.

characters.name: Levi Ackerman
characters.trait: Humanity's strongest, tidiest soldier.

quote.text: If you win, you live. If you lose, you die. If you don't fight, you can't win.

synopsis: Humanity survives behind three great walls, hiding from giants that devour people for no reason anyone understands.
When the outer wall falls, Eren Yeager swears to see what lies beyond — whatever it costs.
What starts as a siege story becomes a mystery about history, freedom, and who gets to write it.
Few shows reframe their own premise this completely, this late.
anime.tagline: Humanity lives behind walls. The walls are not the whole story.
anime.title: Attack on Titan

writer.bio: Manga artist from Hita, Japan. He built Attack on Titan around a single question — what freedom costs — and let the answer get darker as the story grew up with its readers.
writer.name: Hajime Isayama
otherWorks: Attack on Titan: Before the Fall (original concept)
Attack on Titan: No Regrets (original concept)

characters.name: Light Yagami
characters.trait: Genius with a god complex.

characters.name: L
characters.trait: Sugar-fuelled deduction.

characters.name: Ryuk
characters.trait: A bored god of death.

characters.name: Misa Amane
characters.trait: Devotion without brakes.

quote.text: I am justice!

synopsis: A top student finds a notebook: write a name in it, and that person dies.
He decides to use it to cleanse the world of criminals — and a detective known only as L decides to stop him.
What follows is a pure battle of wits, where every move leaves a clue and every clue is a trap.
No fights, no powers used in the open — just two minds trying to name each other.
anime.tagline: A notebook that kills. A genius who picks up the pen.
anime.title: Death Note

writer.bio: Manga writer known for tightly plotted, high-concept thrillers. Ohba writes stories that run on logic and escalation — every chapter of Death Note raises the stakes without breaking its own rules.
writer.name: Tsugumi Ohba

characters.name: Chihiro
characters.trait: Fearful, then fearless.

characters.name: Haku
characters.trait: A river in a boy's form.

characters.name: Yubaba
characters.trait: Runs a bathhouse like a tyrant.

characters.name: No-Face
characters.trait: Loneliness wearing a mask.

quote.text: Nothing that happens is ever forgotten.

synopsis: Ten-year-old Chihiro wanders into a world of spirits and watches her parents turn into pigs.
To free them, she takes a job in a bathhouse for gods, under a witch who steals people's names.
It is a story about work, courage, and remembering who you are when everything tries to rename you.
Winner of the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature.
anime.tagline: A girl takes a job in a bathhouse for spirits to save her parents.
anime.title: Spirited Away

writer.bio: Co-founder of Studio Ghibli and director of some of the most loved animated films ever made. His stories treat young heroes seriously and let wonder do the work that exposition usually does.
writer.name: Hayao Miyazaki

characters.name: Tanjiro Kamado
characters.trait: Kindness as a weapon.

characters.name: Nezuko Kamado
characters.trait: Silent strength.

characters.name: Zenitsu Agatsuma
characters.trait: A coward who never runs when it counts.

characters.name: Inosuke Hashibira
characters.trait: Wild boar, wilder ego.

quote.text: Don't ever give up. Even if it's painful, even if it's agonizing, don't take the easy way out.

synopsis: Tanjiro Kamado comes home to find his family killed by demons — and his sister Nezuko turned into one.
He joins the Demon Slayer Corps to find a cure, carrying his sister in a wooden box on his back.
The fights are spectacular, but the show's real engine is Tanjiro's refusal to stop being kind.
Even its demons get backstories that make you hesitate before cheering.
anime.tagline: A kind boy takes up a sword so his sister can be human again.
anime.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba

writer.bio: Manga artist whose breakout series became a global phenomenon. Gotouge writes earnest, big-hearted heroes and villains with pasts that complicate every victory.
writer.name: Koyoharu Gotouge

characters.name: Thorfinn
characters.trait: Revenge, then emptiness.

characters.name: Askeladd
characters.trait: Cunning as a creed.

characters.name: Thors
characters.trait: A warrior who refused war.

characters.name: Canute
characters.trait: A prince becoming a king.

quote.text: You have no enemies.

synopsis: Thorfinn grows up among Vikings, raised on stories of a peaceful land called Vinland.
After his father is killed, he joins the killer's band with one goal: a fair duel, someday.
The show asks what a warrior is for once the fighting stops — and answers it slowly, honestly.
History, mud, and moral weight: this is a war story about refusing war.
anime.tagline: A boy raised for revenge discovers what revenge leaves behind.
anime.title: Vinland Saga

writer.bio: Manga artist known for long, patient stories that let characters change. Before Vinland Saga he made Planetes, a hard-science-fiction series about space debris collectors.
writer.name: Makoto Yukimura

characters.name: Spike Spiegel
characters.trait: Past catching up in slow motion.

characters.name: Jet Black
characters.trait: The anchor of the Bebop.

characters.name: Faye Valentine
characters.trait: Debts and defences.

characters.name: Edward Wong
characters.trait: Chaos in hacker form.

quote.text: See you, space cowboy.

synopsis: In 2071, bounty hunters Spike and Jet chase bounties across the solar system to keep their ship flying.
Each job is a self-contained story — a heist, a ghost, a joke, a tragedy — scored to jazz.
Underneath the episodic fun, both men are running from pasts that are quietly catching up.
Twenty-six episodes, one of the most quoted endings in the medium.
anime.tagline: Bounty hunters, jazz, and a past that will not stay past.
anime.title: Cowboy Bebop

writer.bio: Director and creative lead of Cowboy Bebop, famous for building shows around music. His work mixes genres freely — westerns, jazz, hip-hop, sci-fi — and always lands the emotional beat.
writer.name: Shinichiro Watanabe

characters.name: Yuji Itadori
characters.trait: A good heart in a cursed world.

characters.name: Megumi Fushiguro
characters.trait: Shadows that obey.

characters.name: Nobara Kugisaki
characters.trait: No apologies, ever.

characters.name: Satoru Gojo
characters.trait: The strongest, unbothered.

quote.text: Nah, I'd win.

synopsis: Yuji Itadori swallows a cursed object to save his friends — and inherits the most dangerous curse alive.
Enrolled at a school for sorcerers, he learns to fight creatures born from human fear and hatred.
The power system is clever, the fights are brutal, and the mentor is famously unbothered.
A modern shonen that moves fast and hits hard.
anime.tagline: He swallowed a cursed finger. Now the curses want him back.
anime.title: Jujutsu Kaisen

writer.bio: Manga artist who built Jujutsu Kaisen from horror influences and a love of clean fight choreography. The series balances dread and humour without ever fully letting up.
writer.name: Gege Akutami

characters.name: Naruto Uzumaki
characters.trait: Loud, stubborn, and impossible to ignore.

characters.name: Sasuke Uchiha
characters.trait: A prodigy chasing power at any price.

characters.name: Sakura Haruno
characters.trait: The team's sharpest mind and fiercest temper.

characters.name: Kakashi Hatake
characters.trait: A masked mentor who reads more than he says.

quote.text: Believe it!

synopsis: In the Hidden Leaf Village, Naruto Uzumaki grows up shunned by the adults around him, for reasons he does not understand.
His answer is loud and simple: he will become Hokage, the village's strongest ninja, and make everyone acknowledge him.
Graduating from the ninja academy lands him on Team 7, alongside rival Sasuke and sharp-tongued Sakura, under the masked jonin Kakashi.
Missions, rivals, and a world of jutsu await — and so does the question of what is sealed inside him.
anime.tagline: An outcast kid with a loud dream: to become Hokage.
anime.title: Naruto

writer.bio: Japanese manga artist who created Naruto, serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 1999 to 2014 and one of the best-selling manga series of all time.
writer.name: Masashi Kishimoto
otherWorks: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations (original story and supervision)

characters.name: Monkey D. Luffy
characters.trait: A rubber captain with an unbreakable will.

characters.name: Nami
characters.trait: The navigator who can read any sea.

characters.name: Nico Robin
characters.trait: An archaeologist hunting the world's true history.

characters.name: Franky
characters.trait: A cyborg shipwright who builds the crew's dreams.

quote.text: I'm going to become the King of the Pirates!

synopsis: Monkey D. Luffy dreams of finding the One Piece, the legendary treasure of the Pirate King, and claiming the title for himself.
The catch: as a boy he ate a Devil Fruit that turned his body to rubber — and made him unable to swim.
So he gathers a crew, one dreamer at a time — a swordsman, a navigator, a cook, and more — and sets sail for the Grand Line.
Decades on, the voyage is still going, and the world it built is the biggest in anime.
anime.tagline: A rubber pirate, a straw hat, and the greatest treasure on the seas.
anime.title: One Piece

writer.bio: Japanese manga artist; One Piece, serialized since 1997, is the best-selling manga series in history, holding the world record for most copies published by a single author.
writer.name: Eiichiro Oda

characters.name: Ichigo Kurosaki
characters.trait: A substitute Soul Reaper with a scowl and a conscience.

characters.name: Rukia Kuchiki
characters.trait: The Soul Reaper who started it all.

characters.name: Uryu Ishida
characters.trait: A Quincy archer with pride to match.

characters.name: Yasutora Sado
characters.trait: Quiet strength, loyal to the end.

quote.text: A blade is only as strong as what it protects.

synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki can see ghosts — a strange gift he treats as normal, until a Soul Reaper named Rukia arrives in his town.
When a Hollow attacks his family, Rukia lends him her powers, and Ichigo becomes a substitute Soul Reaper.
Now he balances school with guiding lost souls and cutting down Hollows, alongside friends who awaken powers of their own.
Behind it all waits the Soul Society — and a set of rules Ichigo has no interest in following.
anime.tagline: A teenager who can see ghosts takes up a Soul Reaper's sword.
anime.title: Bleach

writer.bio: Japanese manga artist; Bleach ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2001 to 2016 and became one of the magazine's defining action series.
writer.name: Tite Kubo

characters.name: Goku
characters.trait: A Saiyan hero who loves a good fight.

characters.name: Vegeta
characters.trait: The proud prince of all Saiyans.

characters.name: Gohan
characters.trait: A scholar with universe-shaking potential.

characters.name: Piccolo
characters.trait: A former villain turned Earth's sternest mentor.

quote.text: It's over 9000!

synopsis: Five years after Dragon Ball, Goku is a father living peacefully — until a warrior from space arrives claiming to be his brother.
The revelation rewrites everything: Goku is a Saiyan, sent to Earth as a baby, and far stronger enemies are on their way.
With his son Gohan, rival Vegeta, and the Namekian Piccolo at his side, he trains, transforms, and defends Earth again and again.
Power levels rise, planets fall, and the fights only get bigger — the template every battle shonen since has followed.
anime.tagline: Earth's strongest hero discovers he came from the stars.
anime.title: Dragon Ball Z

writer.bio: Japanese manga artist who created Dragon Ball; his work shaped modern shonen and sold hundreds of millions of copies worldwide. He passed away in 2024.
writer.name: Akira Toriyama

characters.name: Gon Freecss
characters.trait: Endless optimism with a fishing rod.

characters.name: Killua Zoldyck
characters.trait: An ex-assassin learning to be a kid.

characters.name: Kurapika
characters.trait: Revenge, carried in chains.

characters.name: Leorio Paladiknight
characters.trait: A loud heart chasing a medical licence.

quote.text: If you want to get to know someone, find out what makes them angry.

synopsis: Twelve-year-old Gon Freecss wants to become a Hunter like his father, a legendary Hunter who left home long ago.
The Hunter Exam is notorious for its low success rate and high probability of death — and Gon walks into it smiling.
Along the way he befriends Leorio, Kurapika, and Killua, and the four of them learn what being a Hunter truly costs.
A long adventure about friendship, ambition, and a power system with rules that actually matter.
anime.tagline: A boy takes the world's deadliest exam to find his father.
anime.title: Hunter x Hunter (2011)

writer.bio: Manga artist from Yamagata whose work runs on intricate power systems and moral grey areas. He previously created Yu Yu Hakusho, and Hunter x Hunter's hiatuses are nearly as famous as its arcs.
writer.name: Yoshihiro Togashi

characters.name: Izuku Midoriya
characters.trait: A quirkless kid with a hero's notebook.

characters.name: Katsuki Bakugou
characters.trait: Explosions first, apologies never.

characters.name: All Might
characters.trait: The Symbol of Peace, running on empty.

characters.name: Ochako Uraraka
characters.trait: Zero gravity, full heart.

quote.text: You can become a hero!

synopsis: In a world where 80 percent of people manifest superpowers called Quirks, heroes and villains battle it out everywhere.
Middle school student Izuku Midoriya wants to be a hero more than anything — but he was born Quirkless.
An encounter with All Might, the greatest hero of them all, gives him a chance to change his destiny.
Training at U.A. High's Hero Program, Izuku learns that heroism is less about power than about who you refuse to leave behind.
anime.tagline: Born without a power in a world full of heroes, one boy refuses to give up.
anime.title: My Hero Academia

writer.bio: Manga artist from Aichi whose love of American superhero comics shaped My Hero Academia. Before it, he drew the comedy Oumagadoki Zoo and the action series Barrage.
writer.name: Kohei Horikoshi

characters.name: Saitama
characters.trait: One punch. Zero enthusiasm.

characters.name: Genos
characters.trait: A cyborg disciple with a vengeance.

characters.name: Bang
characters.trait: The old master who sees through the boredom.

characters.name: Amai Mask
characters.trait: The idol hero guarding the top rank.

quote.text: I'm just a hero for fun.

synopsis: Saitama trained relentlessly for three years to become a hero — and lost all of his hair in the process.
Now he is so powerful that no enemy can survive a single punch, and the thrill of battle is gone.
When the cyborg Genos asks to become his disciple, the two join the Hero Association to become certified heroes.
An action-comedy about a man searching for a worthy opponent in a world that cannot give him one.
anime.tagline: The strongest hero alive is bored out of his mind.
anime.title: One Punch Man

writer.bio: Webcomic creator who began One Punch Man as a hobby series drawn in rough strokes. He also created Mob Psycho 100, and his stories pair absurd premises with genuine heart.
writer.name: ONE

characters.name: Shigeo Kageyama
characters.trait: The world's strongest esper, quietly.

characters.name: Arataka Reigen
characters.trait: A con man with a heart of gold.

characters.name: Ritsu Kageyama
characters.trait: The perfect little brother, cracking.

characters.name: Teruki Hanazawa
characters.trait: A rival who learned humility.

quote.text: The strongest power is the one you choose not to use.

synopsis: Kageyama Shigeo, better known as Mob, is a boy who has trouble expressing himself — and happens to be a powerful esper.
Mob is determined to live a normal life and keeps his powers suppressed, but when his emotions surge to 100 percent, something terrible happens.
Surrounded by false espers, evil spirits, and mysterious organizations, he has to decide what his power is actually for.
A story about growing up, told through the most spectacular psychic battles in anime.
anime.tagline: The most powerful esper alive just wants a normal life.
anime.title: Mob Psycho 100

writer.bio: Webcomic creator who began One Punch Man as a hobby series drawn in rough strokes. He also created Mob Psycho 100, and his stories pair absurd premises with genuine heart.
writer.name: ONE

characters.name: Denji
characters.trait: A broke devil hunter with a chainsaw heart.

characters.name: Makima
characters.trait: The calm, unreadable head of Public Safety.

characters.name: Power
characters.trait: The Blood Fiend with no manners and a beloved cat.

characters.name: Aki Hayakawa
characters.trait: The straight-laced devil hunter with a tragic past.

quote.text: Every devil has a price. Every dream has a leash.

synopsis: Denji is a teenage boy living rock-bottom, repaying his dead father's debt by harvesting devil corpses with his chainsaw-dog Pochita.
Betrayed and killed, he makes a contract with Pochita and comes back as Chainsaw Man — a man with a devil's heart.
Now a devil hunter for Special Division 4, Denji just wants the simple things: decent food, a roof, and someone to care about.
Brutal, funny, and strangely tender — a shonen that refuses to behave like one.
anime.tagline: A broke devil hunter makes a deal that turns him into a chainsaw.
anime.title: Chainsaw Man

writer.bio: Manga artist known for chaotic, cinematic storytelling where tenderness and violence sit side by side. Before Chainsaw Man he made Fire Punch, and later the acclaimed one-shots Look Back and Goodbye, Eri.
writer.name: Tatsuki Fujimoto

characters.name: Anya Forger
characters.trait: A telepathic kid who loves peanuts and chaos.

characters.name: Loid Forger
characters.trait: A master spy playing the perfect father.

characters.name: Yor Forger
characters.trait: An assassin who mothers with deadly grace.

characters.name: Bond Forger
characters.trait: A precognitive dog, the family's secret weapon.

quote.text: Waku waku!

synopsis: Ostania and Westalis have been locked in a cold war of spies for decades, and master spy Twilight has just received his hardest mission.
Operation Strix: put together a family in one week to infiltrate an elite school's social gatherings.
The daughter he adopts can read minds. The wife he marries is an assassin. None of them knows the others' secret.
World peace now rests in the hands of a family that is entirely, hilariously fake — and somehow real.
anime.tagline: A spy, an assassin, and a mind-reading child walk into a family.
anime.title: Spy x Family

writer.bio: Manga artist from Ibaraki whose breakout hit Spy x Family blends espionage, comedy, and family warmth. His earlier series Tista and Blade of the Moon Princess showed the same clean, expressive style.
writer.name: Tatsuya Endo

characters.name: Frieren
characters.trait: An elf mage finally learning to treasure time.

characters.name: Fern
characters.trait: A disciplined young mage with a sharp tongue.

characters.name: Stark
characters.trait: A cowardly warrior who never backs down.

characters.name: Himmel
characters.trait: The hero whose memory outlives him.

quote.text: The journey ends. The remembering begins.

synopsis: After the party of heroes defeated the Demon King, peace returned — and the elf mage Frieren watched her human friends grow old.
Generations pass, and Frieren comes face to face with humanity's mortality in a way her long life never prepared her for.
Taking on a new apprentice, she sets out to fulfil old friends' dying wishes and understand the people she barely knew.
A quiet, luminous fantasy about time, grief, and the small moments that turn out to be everything.
anime.tagline: The hero's journey is over. The long goodbye has just begun.
anime.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End

writer.bio: Writer of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, a series that turned a quiet fantasy about grief and time into a global hit. Frieren remains his defining work.
writer.name: Kanehito Yamada

characters.name: Sung Jinwoo
characters.trait: The weakest hunter who became the strongest.

characters.name: Cha Hae-In
characters.trait: An S-rank hunter with a dancer's grace.

characters.name: Yoo Jinho
characters.trait: A loyal friend with a rich father's wallet.

characters.name: Sung Jinah
characters.trait: Jinwoo's younger sister, his reason to fight.

quote.text: Arise.

synopsis: In a world where hunters raid monster-filled gates, Sung Jinwoo is known as the world's weakest hunter.
After being slaughtered in a high-ranking dungeon, he comes back with the System — a program only he can see, levelling him up in every way.
Now he is driven to discover the secrets behind his powers and the dungeon that spawned them.
A pure power fantasy, executed with total confidence and some of the slickest action in modern anime.
anime.tagline: The weakest hunter alive gets a second chance — and a system only he can see.
anime.title: Solo Leveling

writer.bio: South Korean web-novel author whose story of the weakest hunter's rise became a worldwide phenomenon through its webtoon and anime adaptations. Solo Leveling remains his defining work.
writer.name: Chugong

characters.name: Subaru Natsuki
characters.trait: Dies, retries, refuses to quit.

characters.name: Emilia
characters.trait: A half-elf royal candidate with a kind heart.

characters.name: Felix Argyle
characters.trait: A healer with claws out.

characters.name: Priscilla Barielle
characters.trait: Royalty who never doubts herself.

quote.text: Death is not the end. It is the checkpoint.

synopsis: When Subaru Natsuki leaves a convenience store, he is wrenched from his everyday life and dropped into a fantasy world.
Armed with only a bag of groceries and a useless phone, he is beaten to a pulp — until a mysterious girl named Satella saves him.
Then Subaru discovers something impossible: when he dies, history repeats itself, and he wakes up where it started.
A psychological fantasy about what it costs to get every choice right by dying for it, again and again.
anime.tagline: He dies. He wakes up. He tries again.
anime.title: Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World

writer.bio: Light-novel author who began Re:Zero as a web serial. He also co-created the original anime Vivy: Fluorite Eye's Song.
writer.name: Tappei Nagatsuki

characters.name: Rintarou Okabe
characters.trait: Mad scientist, reluctant time traveller.

characters.name: Kurisu Makise
characters.trait: Genius who doesn't believe in the impossible.

characters.name: Mayuri Shiina
characters.trait: The lab's soft heart.

characters.name: Itaru Hashida
characters.trait: Hacker, pervert, loyal friend.

quote.text: El Psy Kongroo.

synopsis: Self-proclaimed mad scientist Rintarou Okabe tinkers with future gadgets in a rickety Akihabara lab with his friends.
Their most promising contraption, the Phone Microwave, turns bananas into green gel — and then does something stranger.
It can send emails to the past, altering the flow of history, and the lab is suddenly holding the key to time itself.
A slow-burn thriller that earns its reputation as one of the tightest-plotted anime ever made.
anime.tagline: A microwave that sends emails to the past. What could go wrong?
anime.title: Steins;Gate

writer.bio: Founder of MAGES (formerly 5pb.) and creator of the Science Adventure series of visual novels. Steins;Gate is the series' most acclaimed entry.
writer.name: Chiyomaru Shikura

characters.name: Lelouch Lamperouge
characters.trait: A prince playing chess with an empire.

characters.name: C.C.
characters.trait: Immortal, unbothered, pizza-loving.

characters.name: Suzaku Kururugi
characters.trait: The soldier who fights from inside.

characters.name: Kallen Stadtfeld
characters.trait: Student by day, ace pilot by night.

quote.text: I, Lelouch vi Britannia, command you.

synopsis: The Holy Empire of Britannia conquered Japan in a month with its Knightmare Frames, stripping the nation to Area 11.
Lelouch, an exiled Imperial prince posing as a student, finds himself in the heart of the resistance.
A chance meeting with a mysterious girl named C.C. gives him Geass — the power of absolute obedience over any person.
Now he can bring down Britannia from within, if the power doesn't consume him first.
anime.tagline: An exiled prince gains the power of absolute obedience — and starts a rebellion.
anime.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion

writer.bio: Screenwriter and series composer behind Code Geass, known for political twists and operatic stakes. He later led Guilty Crown and Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress.
writer.name: Ichiro Okouchi

characters.name: Shinji Ikari
characters.trait: A boy who mustn't run away.

characters.name: Rei Ayanami
characters.trait: Quiet, unreadable, essential.

characters.name: Asuka Langley Souryuu
characters.trait: Pride as armour.

characters.name: Misato Katsuragi
characters.trait: A commander who copes with beer and bravado.

quote.text: I mustn't run away.

synopsis: In the year 2015, humanity's last hope lies with Nerv and their Evangelions — giant machines that can defeat the Angels heralding Earth's ruin.
Fourteen-year-old Shinji Ikari, face to face with his father for the first time in years, is whisked into Nerv's depths.
He must become the pilot of Evangelion Unit-01, with the fate of mankind on his shoulders.
What starts as a mecha action series becomes a psychological drama about loneliness, connection, and the self.
anime.tagline: Fourteen-year-old pilots. Giant machines. The end of the world, again.
anime.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion

writer.bio: Director and co-founder of Gainax, later founder of Studio Khara. Evangelion redefined televised anime by turning a mecha show into a psychological study.
writer.name: Hideaki Anno
otherWorks: Nadia: The Secret of Blue Water

characters.name: Simon
characters.trait: A digger who learns to stand tall.

characters.name: Kamina
characters.trait: Loud, reckless, and impossible to ignore.

characters.name: Yoko Littner
characters.trait: A sniper with perfect aim and little patience.

characters.name: Nia Teppelin
characters.trait: Curiosity in its purest form.

quote.text: Just who the hell do you think I am?!

synopsis: Simon and Kamina grow up in a village buried deep underground, where the sky is only a rumour.
When Simon digs up a strange key and a small buried mech, the two break through to the surface for the first time.
Up there, Beastmen in powerful robots called Gunmen hunt down the last humans — and the trio decide to fight back.
What starts in a hole in the ground grows into a war for the surface, and the show's ambition grows with it.
anime.tagline: Pierce the heavens with your drill.
anime.title: Gurren Lagann

writer.bio: Writer and playwright who led Gurren Lagann's series composition; his scripts run on pure momentum and theatrical bravado.
writer.name: Kazuki Nakashima

characters.name: Mitsuha Miyamizu
characters.trait: A shrine girl dreaming of city life.

characters.name: Taki Tachibana
characters.trait: A Tokyo boy with an artist's eye.

quote.text: We met under a sky split by a comet.

synopsis: Mitsuha, a shrine girl in a mountain town, and Taki, a boy in Tokyo, are complete strangers living separate lives.
Then one night they start swapping bodies — and must live each other's days, leaving notes to keep the other on track.
The arrangement works, awkwardly, until a dazzling comet lights the sky and they both want something more: a real meeting.
A film about connection across distance, drawn in some of the most beautiful skies in animation.
anime.tagline: Two strangers. One borrowed life. A comet overhead.
anime.title: Your Name

writer.bio: Writer-director known for luminous skies and stories about distance; he wrote Your Name as both film and novel.

quote.text: Some apologies take six years to begin.

synopsis: As a child, Shouya Ishida bullied Shouko Nishimiya, the deaf girl in his class, until she left the school — and he took all the blame.
Six years later, isolated and full of regret, he seeks her out with one goal: to make amends.
Their second meeting is not a simple redemption story; old classmates, old wounds, and old habits all get in the way.
A quiet, unsparing film about guilt, forgiveness, and learning to look people in the eye.
anime.tagline: He took her voice. Six years later, he wants it back.
anime.title: A Silent Voice

writer.bio: Manga artist whose stories centre on disability, guilt, and forgiveness; A Silent Voice began as a one-shot before serialization.

quote.text: I love you.

synopsis: The great war has ended, and Violet Evergarden — once known on the battlefield as a weapon — must find a life after it.
She joins a postal service as an Auto Memories Doll, writing letters that carry other people's thoughts into words.
Each client teaches her a new shape of feeling, while she searches for the meaning of words spoken to her on the battlefield.
One of the most beautiful productions Kyoto Animation has ever made, in every sense.
anime.tagline: She writes everyone's feelings but her own.
anime.title: Violet Evergarden

writer.bio: Light novel author who won the Kyoto Animation Award with Violet Evergarden, her debut work.

quote.text: Music is the one place where a lie can tell the truth.

synopsis: Kousei Arima was a piano prodigy — until his mother's death left him unable to hear the sound of his own playing.
Two years later he avoids the piano entirely and lives a colourless life with his two childhood friends.
Then he meets Kaori Miyazono, a violinist who plays free, loud, and gloriously out of step — and she drags him back to music.
A story about grief, first love, and the difference between playing notes perfectly and playing them honestly.
anime.tagline: He stopped hearing the piano. She made him listen again.

quote.text: The court is small. The jump is everything.

synopsis: Inspired by a volleyball ace nicknamed the Little Giant, small-statured Shouyou Hinata revives his middle-school team.
Their first tournament ends in a crushing loss to Tobio Kageyama, the feared King of the Court — and Hinata swears to surpass him.
Then both boys join Karasuno High, and the sworn rivals discover they are now teammates.
A sports series where the real opponent is never the other team — it is the version of yourself that gives up.
anime.tagline: Rivals by fate. Teammates by enrolment.

writer.bio: Former volleyball player whose own middle-school experience shaped Haikyuu!!; the manga ran from 2012 to 2020.

quote.text: Every life weighs the same. That is the whole problem.

synopsis: Dr. Kenzou Tenma is a celebrated brain surgeon in Germany — until one night forces him to choose between two patients: the town's mayor, or a small boy.
He follows his morals, saves the boy, and loses everything he had built.
Years later, a string of murders begins, and all the evidence points to the child he saved.
Tenma crosses Europe to find the truth about his patient, and about what a single choice can unleash.
anime.tagline: He saved a life. The life came back to haunt him.
anime.title: Monster

quote.text: Justice, measured by a machine, is only as just as the machine.

synopsis: In 22nd-century Japan, the Sibyl System scans every citizen's mind and scores their criminal intent — their Psycho-Pass.
Inspectors enforce the system's judgments, backed by Enforcers: former inspectors whose own scores slipped too far.
Rookie inspector Akane Tsunemori arrives believing the system is perfect — and works beside veteran enforcer Shinya Kougami.
A cyberpunk thriller that keeps asking one question: what is justice worth when a machine defines it?
anime.tagline: The system judges your soul before you commit a crime.
anime.title: Psycho-Pass

writer.bio: Writer known for dark, philosophical scripts; he created Psycho-Pass's original concept and series composition.

quote.text: The past gives you one chance to change it. Use it.

synopsis: Satoru Fujinuma, a 29-year-old manga artist, has a strange gift he calls Revival: moments before tragedy strikes, he is sent back a few minutes to stop it.
When he is wrongfully accused of a murder close to home, Revival throws him much further — back to 1988, to his own childhood.
There he realises the present-day crime may be connected to the abduction of a classmate, the solitary Kayo Hinazuki.
Twelve taut episodes about whether one person, given a second childhood, can rewrite a tragedy.
anime.tagline: Sent back 18 years to save one classmate.

quote.text: To be human, or to be hungry — that is the question.

synopsis: Tokyo is haunted by ghouls: creatures who look human and feed on humans, their identities hidden.
Ordinary college student Ken Kaneki meets Rize, a girl who shares his love of reading, at his local café — and his life changes overnight.
An accident leaves Kaneki caught between species: too ghoul for humans, too human for ghouls.
A dark fantasy about hunger, identity, and what you become when both worlds reject you.
anime.tagline: Half human. Half ghoul. Welcome nowhere.

quote.text: The deeper you go, the less you can come back.

synopsis: The Abyss is the world's last unexplored place: a vast pit of strange creatures, ancient relics, and depths nobody has measured.
In Orth, the town on its rim, orphan Riko dreams of becoming a great Cave Raider like her mother.
One day she finds a robot boy with no memories — and together they decide to descend.
A beautiful, brutal adventure where wonder and danger share every step down.
anime.tagline: One pit. No bottom. Descend anyway.

quote.text: Ten thousand players logged in. Nobody can log out.

synopsis: In 2022, the virtual-reality MMO Sword Art Online launches — and ten thousand players dive in with NerveGear helmets.
Then the game's creator traps them all inside: the only way out is to clear all one hundred floors of the floating castle Aincrad.
Worse, death in the game means death in real life, and every floor is deadlier than the last.
Kirito, a solo player by habit, must learn to trust allies — including the formidable Asuna — if anyone is getting out.
anime.tagline: Trapped in a game where losing costs your life.
anime.title: Sword Art Online

writer.bio: Light novel author who won the Dengeki Novel Prize with Accel World and built SAO from a web novel.
